entities.name: Rolf Bjørn Backe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rolf Bjørn Backe was a Norwegian footballer, bandy player, and business person. He was born in Gjøvik. He became the Norwegian cup champion with the club SK Gjøvik-Lyn in 1962, scoring twice in the final. He played 18 matches for the national football team.
